sloka: वक्तव्यम् च नर श्रेष्ठ श्रूयताम् वचनम् मम ।भ्राता यवीयान् धर्मज्ञ एष राजा कुशध्वजः ॥१-७२-४॥
transliteration: vaktavyam ca nara śreṣṭha śrūyatām vacanam mama ।bhrātā yavīyān dharmajña eṣa rājā kuśadhvajaḥ ॥1-72-4॥

translations.english: O Best of men my words deserve to be heard. This younger brother king Kusadhwaja is knower of righteousness.
